entry.content: • (Cloud Storage) Updated gcloud storage rsync to default decompresses downloaded gzip files to match the behavior of gcloud storage cp. To retain the previous behavior, use the new --do-not-decompress flag.
entry.summary: The `gcloud storage rsync` command now defaults to decompressing downloaded gzip files. This change aligns its behavior with `gcloud storage cp`. To keep the old behavior, use the new `--do-not-decompress` flag.
entry.title: Breaking Changes: Cloud Storage rsync decompression behavior change

entry.content: • Updated Linux bundled Python for the gcloud CLI to 3.14.6 to resolve CVE-2026-34182.
entry.summary: The gcloud CLI has been updated to Python 3.14.6 to address a security vulnerability (CVE-2026-34182). This update ensures the continued security and stability of the command-line interface.
entry.title: Google Cloud CLI: Gcloud CLI Python Update

entry.content: • Fixed a performance regression in gcloud artifacts docker images list when listing a large number of image versions.
entry.summary: We've resolved a performance issue in the Artifact Registry where listing a large number of Docker image versions could be slow. This update ensures a smoother experience when managing your container images.
entry.title: Artifact Registry: Artifact Registry performance improvements

entry.content:
• Promoted gcloud biglake delta-sharing <catalogs|shares|schemas|tables> to GA.
  • Promoted gcloud biglake data-product-sharing publish to GA.
  • Added lakehouse option to --catalog=type flag to gcloud biglake iceberg catalogs.
  • Added gcloud biglake hive tables update to beta.
entry.summary: BigLake announces the General Availability of its Delta Sharing and Data Product Sharing capabilities. New features include the 'lakehouse' option for Iceberg catalogs and the beta release of Hive table updates.
entry.title: BigLake: BigLake GA and New Features

entry.content:
• Added environment information to the user-agent HTTP header.
  • Added support for --label flag in bq cp, bq extract, and bq load commands to configure job-level labels.
  • Fixed 'bq show' command failures displaying timestamps without fractional seconds.
entry.summary: The BigQuery command-line tool has been updated with enhanced environment information in the user-agent header. New support for job-level labels has been added to `bq cp`, `bq extract`, and `bq load` commands, along with a fix for `bq show` command failures related to timestamp formatting.
entry.title: BigQuery: BigQuery command-line tool improvements

entry.content:
• Added gcloud datalineage runs command group to manage data lineage runs.
  • Added gcloud datalineage lineage-events command group to manage data lineage runs.
entry.summary: Introducing new gcloud commands to manage data lineage runs and lineage events. This enhancement allows for better control and organization of your data lineage information.
entry.title: Cloud Data Lineage: Manage Data Lineage Runs

entry.content:
• Added --enable-catalog-publishing flag to gcloud dataplex datascans create data-documentation and gcloud dataplex datascans update data-documentation commands.
  • Added --mode flag to gcloud dataplex datascans create data-profile and gcloud dataplex datascans update data-profile commands to support specifying profiling mode.
entry.summary: New flags for Dataplex data scans allow enabling catalog publishing and specifying profiling modes. These updates improve data documentation and profiling capabilities within Dataplex.
entry.title: Cloud Dataplex: Dataplex data scanning enhancements

entry.content: • Promoted gcloud dataproc batches submit pyspark-notebook to GA.
entry.summary: Cloud Dataproc is pleased to announce that the `gcloud dataproc batches submit pyspark-notebook` command is now generally available. This feature allows users to easily submit PySpark notebooks for execution on Dataproc clusters. This marks a significant step in simplifying notebook-based data processing workflows.
entry.title: Cloud Dataproc: Dataproc Notebooks Now Generally Available

entry.content: • Promoted support for agent-registry resource type in gcloud iap web IAM commands to GA.
entry.summary: Cloud Identity-Aware Proxy now fully supports the agent-registry resource type for IAM commands. This promotion to General Availability enhances security for managing access to your agent registry resources.
entry.title: Cloud Identity-Aware Proxy: IAP support for Agent Registry promoted to GA

entry.content:
• (Alpha, Beta) Added --folder flag to gcloud kms autokey-config show-effective-config to retrieve the effective Cloud KMS Autokey configuration for folders. The --project and --folder flags are now optional, defaulting to the current project.
  • Added --hsm-trusted-wrapping flag to gcloud kms keys create and gcloud kms keys versions import to enable trusted wrapping capabilities.
  • Promoted gcloud kms keys versions export-trusted-key-wrapped and gcloud kms keys versions import-trusted-key-wrapped to GA.
  • Added --crypto-key-version-name and --two-factor-public-key-pem flags to gcloud kms single-tenant-hsm proposal create for --operation-type=upgrade_key_trust.
entry.summary: New features for Cloud Key Management Service include folder-level autokey configuration, trusted wrapping for key import/export, and enhanced options for single-tenant HSM key upgrades.
entry.title: Cloud Key Management Service: KMS Autokey and HSM Updates

entry.content: • Added util function to validate and remove byte units from broker disk input.
entry.summary: A new utility function simplifies disk management for your Kafka brokers. It validates and removes byte units from disk input, streamlining operations and reducing potential errors.
entry.title: Cloud Managed Kafka: Manage Kafka Disks Easily

entry.content: • Modified gcloud run services proxy to fail immediately if the service has its default URL disabled.
entry.summary: The `gcloud run services proxy` command now fails immediately if a service's default URL is disabled. This change improves the user experience by providing faster feedback in such scenarios.
entry.title: Cloud Run: Cloud Run service proxy update

entry.content: • Upgraded --storage-auto-increase-limit flag for gcloud sql instances create and gcloud sql instances patch commands to GA.
entry.summary: The --storage-auto-increase-limit flag for Cloud SQL instances is now generally available. This feature automatically increases your instance's storage when it's running low. You can use this flag with the create and patch commands for Cloud SQL instances.
entry.title: Cloud SQL: Storage auto-increase now generally available

entry.content: • Updated gcloud storage Parallel Composite Uploads to atomically clean up temporary parts, avoiding bucket soft-delete costs.
entry.summary: Cloud Storage now atomically cleans up temporary parts for parallel composite uploads. This update helps avoid unnecessary costs associated with bucket soft-delete.
entry.title: Cloud Storage: Cloud Storage: Improved Composite Uploads

entry.content: • Added support for Lustre dynamic tier in gcloud cluster-director clusters commands.
entry.summary: Cluster Director now supports Lustre dynamic tiering. This enhancement is available through the `gcloud cluster-director clusters` commands, allowing for more flexible storage management within your clusters.
entry.title: Cluster Director: Lustre dynamic tier support

entry.content: • Updated gcloud compliance-manager commands to support project-level resources.
entry.summary: The Compliance Manager has been updated to support project-level resources. This enhancement allows for more granular control and management of compliance settings within your projects.
entry.title: Compliance Manager: Compliance Manager Updates

entry.content:
• Promoted --nat-ips-per-endpoint flag to GA in gcloud compute service-attachments create and gcloud compute service-attachments update.
  • Promoted gcloud compute hosts and gcloud compute reservations hosts to beta.
  • Added gcloud compute sole-tenancy node-templates test-iam-permissions command to test IAM permissions on a node template in beta, preview, and GA.
  • Added gcloud compute instant-snapshots set-iam-policy command to support setting IAM policy bindings for instant snapshots in alpha, beta, preview, and GA.
  • Added gcloud compute network-attachments test-iam-permissions command to test IAM permissions on a network attachment in beta, preview, and GA.
  • Added gcloud beta compute instance-groups managed adopt-instances to support adopting instances into regional managed instance groups.
  • Added gcloud compute instant-snapshots test-iam-permissions command to test IAM permissions on an instant snapshot in beta, preview, and GA.
  • Added get-iam-policy and set-iam-policy commands to gcloud compute firewall-policies and gcloud compute network-firewall-policies to manage policy-level IAM policy.
  • Promote the --location flag of gcloud compute interconnects update to GA.
  • Added gcloud compute backend-buckets test-iam-permissions command to test IAM permissions on backend buckets.
  • Promoted --on-repair-allow-changing-zone flag to GA in gcloud compute instance-groups managed create and gcloud compute instance-groups managed update.
  • Added gcloud compute interconnects test-iam-permissions command to test IAM permissions on a Compute Engine interconnect in beta.
  • Added gcloud compute instant-snapshot-groups test-iam-permissions command.
  • Added test-iam-permissions command to gcloud compute target-tcp-proxies to test IAM permissions on a target TCP proxy. Global proxies are supported in all tracks, and regional proxies are supported in alpha and beta tracks.
  • Added support for displaying dynamic field GRACEFUL_SHUTDOWN_TIMESTAMP to gcloud compute instance-groups managed list-instances in GA, beta and alpha.
  • Added gcloud compute service-attachments set-iam-policy command to set IAM policy on a service attachment in beta, preview, and GA.
  • Added --async flag to gcloud compute instance-groups managed delete.
  • Promoted --load-balancing-scheme flag to GA in gcloud compute target-tcp-proxies create.
  • Promoted --instances flag of gcloud create instance-groups managed resize-requests create to GA to support specific instance names.
  • Added gcloud compute reservations sub-blocks test-iam-permissions command to beta, preview and GA release tracks.
  • Added on-update-action enum class to --create-disk flag for an instance creation. And it is added to the following release tracks alpha, beta, preview, and GA.
  • Added gcloud compute external-vpn-gateways test-iam-permissions command to test IAM permissions on an external VPN gateway.
  • Added gcloud compute sole-tenancy node-groups test-iam-permissions command to test IAM permissions on a node group in alpha, beta, GA, and preview.
  • Promoted --identity, --identity-certificate and --most-disruptive-allowed-action flags to GA.
  • Added gcloud compute disks bulk set-labels command to alpha, beta, ga, and preview release tracks.
entry.summary: New features and GA promotions for Compute Engine gcloud commands, including enhanced IAM permissions testing, service attachment management, and instance group operations. This release also introduces support for adopting instances into managed instance groups and managing disk labels in bulk.
entry.title: Compute Engine: Compute Engine gcloud updates

entry.content: • Promoted gcloud developer-connect insights-configs deployment-events list and describe commands to GA.
entry.summary: We are excited to announce that the `gcloud developer-connect insights-configs deployment-events list` and `describe` commands have been promoted to General Availability. This milestone brings robust insights into your deployment events directly to your fingertips.
entry.title: Developer Connect: Deployment Event Insights Now Generally Available

entry.content:
• Added KCP_VPA option to --logging flag of gcloud container clusters create to enable VPA Decision Logs feature.
  • Added KCP_VPA option to --logging flag of gcloud container clusters create-auto to enable VPA Decision Logs feature.
  • Added KCP_VPA option to --logging flag of gcloud container clusters update to enable VPA Decision Logs feature.
  • Added node config options nodeVfioConfig to gcloud container clusters create, gcloud container node-pools create, and gcloud container node-pools update command which contains VFIO-related configurations for this node.
  • Added node config options diskIoScheduler to gcloud container clusters create, gcloud container node-pools create, and gcloud container node-pools update command which contains the configuration for the disk IO scheduler.
  • Promoted Rollbackable Upgrades (Two-Step Upgrades) to GA. Added --control-plane-soak-duration flag to gcloud container clusters upgrade and promoted gcloud container clusters complete-control-plane-upgrade to GA.
  • Promoted --managed-otel-scope flag to GA in gcloud container clusters create to enable Managed OpenTelemetry feature.
  • Promoted --managed-otel-scope flag to GA in gcloud container clusters create-auto to enable Managed OpenTelemetry feature.
  • Promoted --managed-otel-scope flag to GA in gcloud container clusters update to enable Managed OpenTelemetry feature.
  • Additional kubectl versions:
  • kubectl.1.30 (1.30.14)
  • kubectl.1.31 (1.31.14)
  • kubectl.1.32 (1.32.13)
  • kubectl.1.33 (1.33.13)
  • kubectl.1.34 (1.34.9)
  • kubectl.1.35 (1.35.6)
  • kubectl.1.36 (1.36.2)
entry.summary: New features for Kubernetes Engine include VPA Decision Logs, node configuration options for VFIO and disk IO scheduling, and the General Availability of Rollbackable Upgrades. We've also promoted the Managed OpenTelemetry feature to GA and added support for several new kubectl versions.
entry.title: Kubernetes Engine: Kubernetes Engine Updates

entry.content:
• Promoted --release-channel and --accelerated-security-patch-enabled flags to GA for gcloud looker instances create and gcloud looker instances update.
  • Added RELEASE_CHANNEL and ACCELERATED_SECURITY_PATCH_ENABLED columns to gcloud looker instances describe output in GA track.
entry.summary: Key flags for managing Looker instances, including release channels and accelerated security patches, have moved to General Availability for creation and update commands. The describe command now also reflects these settings in its output.
entry.title: Looker: Looker Instance Flags Now Generally Available

entry.content: • Added support for project-level security profiles to gcloud network-security security-profiles wildfire-analysis commands in BETA.
entry.summary: You can now manage security profiles at the project level using `gcloud network-security security-profiles wildfire-analysis` commands, now available in beta. This enhancement allows for broader application of security policies across your projects.
entry.title: Network Security: Project-level security profiles in beta

entry.content: • Deprecated --s3-compatible-mode flag in gcloud transfer agents install. It is no longer needed as Transfer Service automatically detects S3-compatible job.
entry.summary: The `--s3-compatible-mode` flag for `gcloud transfer agents install` has been deprecated. Transfer Service now automatically detects S3-compatible jobs, making the flag unnecessary.
entry.title: Transfer: Transfer Service S3 Compatibility Update

entry.content:
• Updated gcloud vmware private-clouds create command to use full resource names for --preferred-zone and --secondary-zone flags when creating a stretched private cloud. This update ensures compliance with VPC Service Controls.

Subscribe to these release notes at https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/google-cloud-sdk-announce.
entry.summary: The `gcloud vmware private-clouds create` command has been updated to use full resource names for zone flags when creating stretched private clouds. This change ensures compliance with VPC Service Controls.
entry.title: Vmware Engine: Vmware Engine stretched private cloud zone updates
